broadcast_data_from_rank: broadcast data or function result from a specified rank to all ranks in a process group
broadcast_function_result: broadcast the result of a callable function executed on rank 0 to all other ranks
all_gather_from_all_ranks: gather data or function results from all ranks with stage-name synchronization guard
all_gather_enforce_type: gather objects across ranks and enforce type consistency with a custom type checker
create_sync_payload: create a SyncPayload dataclass with stage name, success flag, payload, and optional exception
